C1542.title: aBNBc Token Infinite Minting Vulnerability Incident
C1542.summary: In December 2022, the aBNBc token contract of the DeFi protocol Ankr was attacked. The attacker obtained the developer private key, uploaded a new contract with an unauthorized minting method, and minted 60 trillion aBNBc out of thin air, swapping it for USDC and other tokens. Ankr officially estimated the loss at about $5 million in BNB, with the token price nearly zero; the team subsequently compensated affected liquidity providers.
